finding: The live Polymarket US /v1/markets universe (500 markets) is entirely sports category (NFL/MLB/etc.), with zero crypto- or equity-linked markets. The archived lineage is US macro releases (CPI/PPI), sports, and music. Therefore the PolyBolt reference symbols (btcusd/ethusd/aapl) have zero deterministic Polymarket US execution-venue targets.
